notes.title: Whisperwind v1.5
notes.content:
Hi there! Today I released a new fix to many problems reported by the users! See the full log below:
- Fixed a flying piece of toast on the cafeteria (Thanks to Aleks Puhovs)
- Fixed a fatal crash that happened when trying to open the game (Thanks to GoldeBits)
- Updated Steamworks API and Unity version

If you notice a bug or experience crashes, feel free to report on my twitter: @amarogamedev or through my e-mail: contact@amarostudios.com

notes.title: Whisperwind V1.4
notes.content:
Hi there! It has been a while since the last update, but here I am with some noteworthy changes:
- The briefcase puzzle has been changed, it has no more relation with math, just logic.
- The sewers puzzle has been made a little easier to understand.
- Fixes on the Brazilian Portuguese translation (thanks to Guilherme Prt)
- The color bleeding effect is now less visible to prevent more sensitive people to get nausea.
- Minor bug fixes and stability improvements

Hope you guys are doing well and stay strong!
If you have any questions or feedback regarding Whisperwind, feel free to comment down below!

notes.title: Whisperwind update - v1.1
notes.content:
- Changed the "Good ending" so that it reveals a bit more of the story of Whisperwind
- Made some changes to the maze to make it easier to navigate and removed softlocks
- Now you can skip the credits
- Gravity now still applies if you're interacting with an object
- Remade the animation that played on one of the endings
- Now you can't input the code on the nursery door before triggering the gas
- Alt won't turn off the flashlight anymore (you can alt + tab with no worries now!)
- Changed the location of the hint for the Lockdown puzzle
- Corrected a visual bug on the UI of the "About" section on the main menu
- Small bug fixes

The next update will introduce Brazilian Portuguese as a new language available!
